launch_binding.mechanism: Open the verified regular no-follow executable, execute that vnode through /dev/fd, retain the same image at inherited fd 3, and hash fd 3 inside the private model mode before artifact access.
launch_binding.failure: UNSUPPORTED_RUNTIME before artifact access or model work

file_identity.path: absolute UTF-8 operator path no longer than 4096 bytes
file_identity.bytes: uint53 bounded again by the role-specific intake cap

fresh_execution_release.trusted_identity: The exact release SHA256 is supplied independently on the command line; no embedded accepted flag is authority.

exact_fields.release_sha256: hex64 matching the supplied fresh release
exact_fields.native_binary_sha256: hex64 matching the inherited executing image

independent_admission.trusted_identity: The exact admission SHA256 is a separate operator-supplied trust anchor. The release cannot self-admit.

private_request.framing: u32 little-endian byte length followed by exact UTF-8 JSON; maximum 65536 bytes
private_request.completion: The sender writes exactly row_cap request frames. After the matching final result, the adapter validates frozen counts and emits done immediately; it does not wait for EOF or another frame, and the sender need not close stdin. Any later bytes are outside the admitted one-execution protocol.

exact_fields.text_b64: canonical standard padded base64, decoded maximum 8192 bytes
exact_fields.request_extras: JSON object; nonempty means the original outer request schema is unsupported and must reach the core as a refusal without a forward

private_reply.result: Exact native result plus parsed clauses, full role_attention/role_vectors/binding_attention/logits as lowercase little-endian f32 hex, diagnostics, forward count and native comparison receipt.
private_reply.limits: The adapter consumes exactly row_cap frames and then emits done without reading again. External admission/supervision owns rejection of any attempted extra frame. A missing admitted row, forward-cap breach, refusal-cap breach or final count mismatch fails the run.

validation_order: Validate executing-image handle, supplied fresh release bytes/digest and independent admission bytes/digest.
Validate release/admission schema, exact fields, actual binary, target, service contract, plan and every role-bounded file identity.
Validate expected binding and immutable original export release independently.
Only then read the exact artifact and call load_audited.
Construct ComparisonAdmission only from the separately verified original export release bytes/digest plus the fresh runtime identity.
Run compare under the admitted finite population; never call qualify and never listen on a socket.
